  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subrogation">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Handler" name="Case handler" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentReceived" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="ICE_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="ICE_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ForwardToAgency" name="Case forwarded" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Message_ForwardToAgency"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ForwardToAgency" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Subrogation recourse" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PossibleSubrogation" name="Possible subrogation identified"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInformation" name="Obtain information on possible subrogation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse possible?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoRecourse" name="Case closed (no recourse)"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitResponse" name="Await payment, disagreement or deadline"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_DisagreementDeadline" name="Disagreement deadline reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>The duration of the disagreement deadline is not specified in the description.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BookPayment" name="Book payment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Paid" name="Case closed (paid)"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning of disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningRight" name="Insurant right?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DisagreementAccepted" name="Case closed (disagreement accepted)"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardMerge" name="Forward case"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ForwardToAgency" name="Forward case to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_PossibleSubrogation" targetRef="Task_ObtainInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInformation" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="EndEvent_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="ICE_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="ICE_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="ICE_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="ICE_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="EndEvent_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ICE_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningRight" targetRef="EndEvent_DisagreementAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningRight" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="ICE_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="EndEvent_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
